visuals: A sunny Atlantic coast in Portugal with golden cliffs and blue water under a clear summer sky.
script: The weather? Portugal usually has mild temperatures, with sunny summers and rainy winters, especially along the coast. Pack your sunglasses and maybe a raincoat, just in case!

visuals: A rainy winter day in the Portuguese countryside with green hills and dark clouds.
A scenic view of the Douro River winding through steep hills covered in terraced vineyards in Portugal, with a traditional rabelo boat on the water.
script: Now for my favorite part: landscapes! The Douro River winds through hills and vineyards in the north. You can even spot traditional boats called rabelos gliding past rows of grapevines!

visuals: A colorful Rooster of Barcelos statue, a traditional Portuguese symbol, displayed in a vibrant town square.
script: Speaking of symbols, keep your eyes peeled for the Rooster of Barcelos. This colorful bird is EVERYWHERE, bringing good luck like a feathered charm.

visuals: An Iberian wolf standing in a misty mountain forest in Portugal.
script: High in Portugal’s mountains lives the Iberian wolf: a protected species with mysterious golden eyes. Who’s the (mountain) boss now?

visuals: A rare Iberian lynx prowling through the dense cork oak forests of Portugal.
script: If you’re super lucky, a rare Iberian lynx sneaking through the forest!

visuals: A group of pink flamingos wading through a shallow lagoon in the Algarve region of Portugal.
script: Oh, and down below? You'll also find bright flamingos wading through lagoons.

visuals: The iconic view of Lisbon, Portugal, with its red-roofed buildings, pastel walls, and the historic yellow tram climbing a steep hill.
script: Quick quiz: can you name Portugal’s capital? It’s Lisbon! A city built on seven hills with pastel-colored houses, it almost looks like it’s been sprinkled with candy!

visuals: The colorful Ribeira district in Porto, Portugal, with its ancient houses along the Douro River and the Dom Luís I Bridge.
script: Then there’s Porto, a city famous for its sweet wine, colorful riverside streets, and epic bridges that stretch across the Douro River… wow, what a view!

visuals: The historic University of Coimbra in Portugal with its ancient stone buildings and students in traditional black capes.
script: And Coimbra? Home to students who wear long black capes. Yep, like real-life wizards at a school of magic!

visuals: A narrow, historic street in the Alfama district of Lisbon, Portugal, with laundry hanging from balconies and patterned tile walls (azulejos).
script: When it comes to language, most folks speak Portuguese, but guess what? In some northeast villages, they speak a rare one called Mirandese. Kind of like a secret code!

visuals: A pleasant afternoon at the Praça do Comércio in Lisbon, Portugal, with pedestrians walking near the yellow arches and the Tagus River.
script: Portugal’s home to about 10 million people: that’s a bit more than New York City! So, imagine one giant, delicious dinner party.

visuals: A traditional Portuguese dish of Bacalhau à Brás (shredded cod with potatoes and eggs) served on a platter with olives.
script: Speaking of food… mmm! Bacalhau is dried cod, and they cook it hundreds of tasty ways. Grilled, baked, or in a creamy casserole… yum!

visuals: A tray of freshly baked Portuguese pastéis de nata (custard tarts) with their characteristic burnt tops, dusted with cinnamon.
script: Don’t miss pastéis de nata! These warm custard tarts are usually served in cafés, sometimes with cinnamon on top. Dessert? YES, please!

visuals: A lively street festival in Lisbon for the Feast of Saint Anthony, with people grilling sardines and colorful decorations overhead.
script: And who’s hungry for a party? At summer street fests called Festas dos Santos! People dance, decorate, and grill sardines right on the street. Talk about flavor and fun!

visuals: A soulful Fado singer performing in a dimly lit, traditional tavern in Lisbon, accompanied by a Portuguese guitar.
script: Ready to hear something soulful? Fado is a traditional music style where singers tell emotional stories with twangy Portuguese guitars. It’s like music that hugs your heart.

visuals: A historic illustration of Portuguese caravel ships sailing across the Atlantic Ocean during the Age of Discovery.
script: And history? In the 1400s, Portuguese explorers set out by ship, sailing to Africa, Asia, and the Americas. These sea journeys changed world maps forever.

visuals: A vintage photo of Portuguese soccer legend Eusébio celebrating a goal during the 1966 World Cup.
script: Flash forward to 1966: football legend Eusébio led Portugal to third place in their first big tournament. What a thrilling kickoff!

visuals: Portuguese soccer superstar Cristiano Ronaldo celebrating a goal in his national team jersey.
script: Today, soccer still rules. Cristiano Ronaldo, born on Madeira Island, is one of the world’s top players.

visuals: Portuguese triathlete Vanessa Fernandes racing on a professional track with her national team uniform.
script: And Vanessa Fernandes? She crushed it in triathlon, racing to Olympic silver in 2008!

visuals: Massive waves crashing on the coast of Nazaré, Portugal, with surfers attempting to ride the giant swells.
script: Before we go, here’s a splashy fact: Portugal’s coast is over 800 kilometers long with waves so big, surfers come from around the planet. Cowabunga!
